title: A Study of Implicit Ranking Unfairness in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of gender-associated user names in ranking prompts to measure disparities in recommendation outputs and topic distributions.
Counterfactual substitution of race-associated user names in ranking prompts to evaluate differences in recommended job and news categories.
Substituting user names and university email domains associated with different continents/regions to measure stereotype-driven differences in ranking outcomes.
